prompt: A single slender tide gauge staff standing upright in the open sea, seen from slightly above: a tall, narrow, flat wooden board fixed to a thin post that rises straight out of the water, its face marked from top to bottom with a regular ladder of short plain horizontal tick marks, alternating longer and shorter strokes, the bare scale of a ruler and nothing else on it. On top of the staff, a little plain chartreuse yellow-green #b4c424 pennant flag on a thin mast. The staff is drawn in crisp off-white and ink grey line art with fine engraved shading. From the foot of the staff, concentric ripples spread out across the water surface, drawn as fine engraved off-white lines in the water itself: wide flattened ellipses seen in perspective, much wider than tall, the nearer arcs larger and bolder, the farther arcs thinner and fading into the wave lines, dying out well before the left third of the image. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, bathymetric contour lines with small depth soundings drawn as tiny dots, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no gradient, no text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no figures on the staff, no watermark, no horizon, no sky. The engraved sea fills the whole wide image edge to edge. The staff is medium-small and stands in the right half of the image with water all around it; the entire left third of the image is completely calm open water with nothing in it, only quiet engraved wave lines. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and a touch of chartreuse yellow-green #b4c424 on the pennant only.
